race.description: Hkjc World Pool Silver Shadow Stakes (G2)
race.comment: CHERRY BOMSHELL (1) Percy Sykes winner resuming. Made rapid improvement in her first campaign with the three wins culminating in the G2 win on April 11. Trialled well against the older horses and Ben Thompson stays in the saddle. Can finish over the top of these with the 57kg. PEMBREY (2) Queensland filly who won the Magic Night in the autumn, resuming. Never on the track when a fading fourteenth in the G1 Golden Slipper last March. Cleared out for a sharp trial win over 1050m at Deagon on August 4. Has another sticky gate to contend with and expected to play a leading role. AGRARIAN GIRL (3) lightly raced filly resuming. Won the LR Lonhro on debut, then no match for Chayan in the G2 Reisling over 1200m here last March. Back from a lengthy break and will take catching. BANGKOK HOTTIE (5) never on the track first up when she loomed strongly only to fade late when third over 1100m at this track. Has a fitness edge today and look for her late. SCREEN ICON (11) stays in the mix.
